academic_translation:
When seized by the messengers of Yama,
What help are kinsmen, and what help are friends?
If at that time merit alone is a refuge,
I have not relied upon even that.
translation: When the messengers of Yama grab me, how can my family and friends help? If only a store of goodness can keep me safe at that time, I have not relied on even that.

academic_translation:
O Protectors, I, through heedlessness,
Unaware of such terrors as these,
For the sake of this impermanent life,
Have committed many misdeeds.
translation: O Protectors, I did not know about these terrors because of my carelessness. For the sake of this not lasting life, I have done many harmful deeds.

academic_translation:
Even a person being led today
To a place where their limbs will be severed is terrified;
With a parched mouth, distressed eyes, and the like,
If they appear transformed from how they were before,
translation: Even a person being led away today to have their limbs cut off is terrified. Their mouth is dry and their eyes are upset. They look completely changed from how they were before.

academic_translation:
Seized by the messengers of Yama
With their terrifying physical forms,
And stricken by the disease of great terror,
What need to mention their utter misery?
translation: So what about someone grabbed by the messengers of Yama with their terrifying bodies? They are struck by the sickness of great fear. There is no need to even mention their complete misery.

academic_translation:
"Who will perfectly protect me
From this great terror?"
With eyes wide open in panic,
I will search the four directions for a refuge.
translation: I will ask, "Who will really protect me from this great terror?" My eyes will be wide open in panic. I will search the four directions for a shelter.

academic_translation:
Seeing no refuge in the four directions,
I will then fall into utter despair.
If there is no refuge in that place,
What shall I do at that time?
translation: I will see no shelter in the four directions. Then I will fall into deep despair. If there is no shelter in that place, what will I do at that time?

academic_translation:
Therefore, in the Victors, Protectors of wandering beings,
Who strive for the purpose of protecting wandering beings,
The mighty ones who dispel all fears,
From this very day, I take refuge.
translation: From this very day, the Victorious Ones are the ones I go to for shelter. They are the Protectors of beings. They work hard to keep beings safe. These strong ones chase away all fears.

academic_translation:
In the Dharma they have realized,
Which dispels the fears of saṃsāra,
And in the assembly of bodhisattvas,
Likewise, I perfectly take refuge.
translation: In the same way, their teachings are what I go to for shelter. These teachings chase away the fears of the cycle of rebirth. The group of awakening heroes is also who I go to for shelter.

academic_translation:
Terrified by fear, I
Offer myself to Samantabhadra;
To Mañjuśrī, I myself
Shall offer my body.
translation: I am terrified by fear. So, I offer myself to Samantabhadra. I also give my body to Manjushri.

academic_translation:
Whose conduct through compassion is unerring,
To the protector Avalokiteśvara as well,
I cry out with an anguished voice:
"Please protect me, one possessing misdeeds!"

locked_terms.use: one who has done harmful deeds

translation: His actions are always perfect because of his compassion. I cry out in a sad voice to the protector Avalokiteshvara. I say, 'Please protect me, one who has done harmful deeds!'

academic_translation:
To noble Ākāśagarbha,
And to Kṣitigarbha,
And to all the Protectors with great compassion,
Seeking refuge, I cry out from my heart.
translation: Looking for shelter, I cry out from my heart to noble Akashagarbha. I also call to Kshitigarbha. I cry out to every Protector who has great compassion.

academic_translation:
Seeing whom, the messengers of Yama
And other malicious beings
Flee in terror to the four directions,
I take refuge in the Vajra-wielder.
translation: The Thunderbolt-holder is the one I go to for shelter. When the messengers of Yama and other harmful beings see him, they are terrified. They run away in all four directions.

academic_translation:
Previously, I transgressed your commands;
Now, having seen great fear,
I take refuge in you.
Please swiftly dispel my fears!
translation: In the past, I broke your rules. Now I have seen great danger. You are who I go to for shelter. Please take away my fears quickly!

academic_translation:
Even when frightened by an ordinary illness,
If one must act according to the physician's words,
When one is constantly stricken by the disease
Of a hundred faults such as desire, what need to mention?
translation: If we are scared of a normal illness, we must follow the doctor's orders. So of course we must when we are always sick! We have a disease made of a hundred faults like longing.

academic_translation:
If even just one of them, in Jambudvīpa,
Destroys all the people dwelling there,
And no other medicine to cure them
Can be found anywhere in all directions—
translation: Just one of these faults can destroy all the people living in Jambudvipa. No other medicine can cure them. We cannot find a cure anywhere at all.

academic_translation:
In that case, of the Omniscient Physician
Who draws out all pain,
The intention not to act according to his commands
Is extreme ignorance and an object of reproach.
translation: The All-Knowing Doctor takes away all pain. Not wanting to follow his orders is extreme ignorance. Anyone who ignores him should be scolded.

academic_translation:
Even at a small, ordinary precipice,
If one must remain careful,
Of falling a thousand yojanas
Into a long-lasting precipice, what need to mention?
translation: We must be careful even near a small, normal cliff. So of course we must be careful near a huge drop! We could fall a thousand leagues and be trapped for a long time.

academic_translation:
Thinking, "I will not die this very day,"
It is not right to remain at ease.
The time when I will cease to be
Will undoubtedly arrive.
translation: It is wrong for me to relax and think, 'I will not die today.' The time when I will be gone will definitely come.

academic_translation:
Who has given me fearlessness?
How will I definitely escape from this?
If I will undoubtedly cease to exist,
How can my mind remain at ease?
translation: Who has made me safe from fear? How will I make sure I escape from this? If I will definitely stop existing one day, how can my mind be at peace?

academic_translation:
From what was previously experienced and has perished,
What remains for me?
By being deeply attached to that,
I have transgressed the teacher's commands.
translation: Everything I felt in the past is gone. What is left of it for me? Because I held on to those things so tightly, I broke the teacher's commands.

academic_translation:
Leaving behind this lifetime, and likewise
Relatives and friends,
If I must go somewhere alone,
What is the use of all friends and non-friends?
translation: I will have to leave this life behind. I will also leave my family and friends. If I must go somewhere completely alone, what is the use of having friends or enemies?

academic_translation:
From non-virtue, suffering arises.
'How will I definitely escape from that?'
Constantly, day and night, it is right for me
To ponder only this.
translation: Suffering comes from a bad deed. I must ask myself how I will ever escape from that. It is right for me to think only about this question all day and all night.

academic_translation:
Because of my unknowing and ignorance,
Natural misdeeds or
Whatever proscribed misdeeds there are—
Whichever of these I have committed,
translation: Because of my unknowing and ignorance, I have done bad things. I have committed deeds wrong in themselves. I have also done all kinds of forbidden harmful deeds.

academic_translation:
Directly in the presence of the Protectors,
With joined palms and a mind terrified of suffering,
I pay homage again and again,
And I confess all of those.
translation: Right in front of the Protectors, I stand with my hands pressed together. My mind is terrified of suffering. I bow down again and again, and I own up to all of those.

academic_translation:
I pray that the Guides regard my misdeeds
As faults.
Since this is not good,
Henceforth I will never do it.
translation: I pray that the Guides see my harmful deeds as faults. Because this is not good, I will never do it again.

academic_translation: From Entering the Way of the Bodhisattva, the second chapter, Confession of Misdeeds.

locked_terms.use: Entering the Way of the Awakening Hero

translation: From Entering the Way of the Awakening Hero, the second chapter: Confessing Harmful Deeds.

academic_translation:
In the virtue of all sentient beings
That brings rest from the suffering of the lower realms,
And in suffering beings abiding in happiness,
With joy I rejoice.
translation: I joyfully rejoice in the good deeds of all living beings that bring rest from the suffering of the unhappy realms. I also rejoice when suffering beings find happiness.

tibetan: བྱང་ཆུབ་རྒྱུར་གྱུར་དགེ་བསགས་པ། ། དེ་ལ་རྗེས་སུ་ཡི་རང་ངོ་། ། ལུས་ཅན་འཁོར་བའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ་ལས། ། ངེས་པར་ཐར་ལ་ཡི་རང་ངོ་། ། སྐྱོབ་པ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་བྱང་ཆུབ་དང་། ། རྒྱལ་སྲས་ས་ལའང་ཡི་རང་ངོ་། །
academic_translation:
In the accumulated virtue that becomes the cause for awakening,
In that I rejoice.
For embodied beings, from the suffering of saṃsāra,
In definite liberation I rejoice.
In the awakening of the Saviours, and
In the levels of the children of the Victors too, I rejoice.

locked_terms.use: level of the children of the Victorious Ones

translation: I rejoice in the gathered good deeds that lead to awakening. I rejoice in the complete freedom of beings with a body from the suffering of the cycle of rebirth. I rejoice in the awakening of the Protectors. I also rejoice in the levels of the children of the Victorious Ones.

academic_translation:
Bringing happiness to all sentient beings,
In the ocean of virtue of the generation of bodhicitta, and
In the deeds that benefit sentient beings,
With joy I rejoice.
translation: I joyfully rejoice in the ocean of good deeds from the birth of the awakening mind, which brings happiness to all living beings. I also rejoice in the actions that help living beings.

academic_translation:
To the Buddhas of all directions,
I join my palms and pray:
For sentient beings suffering and bewildered in darkness,
Please light the lamp of the Dharma.
translation: I put my hands together and pray to the Buddhas everywhere. Living beings are lost in the dark with their suffering. Please light the lamp of the teachings for them.

academic_translation:
To the Victors who wish to pass into nirvāṇa,
I join my palms and pray:
Do not leave these wandering beings in blindness,
But please remain for countless eons.
translation: I put my hands together and pray to the Victorious Ones who wish to pass into freedom from sorrow. Do not leave these blind wandering beings behind. Please stay with us for countless great ages.

academic_translation:
Having done all this in this way,
Whatever virtue I have accumulated,
By that, may all the suffering
Of all sentient beings be dispelled.
translation: By all the good deeds I have gathered in this way, may the suffering of every living being be taken away completely.

academic_translation:
For as long as wandering beings are sick,
Until they are cured of their illness,
May I become the medicine and the doctor,
And act as their nurse.
translation: As long as any beings are sick, may I help them until they are cured. May I be their medicine, their doctor, and their nurse.

academic_translation:
By raining down showers of food and drink,
May I dispel the suffering of hunger and thirst.
During the intermediate eon of famine,
May I myself become food and drink.
translation: May I rain down food and drink to take away the suffering of hunger and thirst. During the middle great age of famine, may I become food and drink myself.

academic_translation:
For sentient beings who are destitute and poor,
May I become an inexhaustible treasure;
As all the various needed provisions,
May I remain closely present before them.
translation: For every living being who is poor and has nothing, may I become a treasure that never runs out. May I stay right in front of them as everything they need.

academic_translation:
My body and likewise my possessions,
And all virtues of the three times,
In order to accomplish the welfare of all sentient beings,
I shall give away without a sense of loss.
translation: I will freely give away my body and my belongings. I will give away my good deeds from the past, present and future. I will do this without feeling a loss to help all living beings.

academic_translation:
By giving up everything, nirvāṇa is attained,
And my mind seeks to accomplish nirvāṇa;
Since I must give up everything all the same,
It is best given to sentient beings.
translation: Giving up everything brings freedom from sorrow. My mind wants to reach this freedom from sorrow. Since I must give up everything anyway, it is best to give it to living beings.

academic_translation:
Since, to all embodied beings, I
Have already given this body for their pleasure,
Whether they constantly kill and revile it,
Or strike it and so forth, let them do as they please.
translation: I have already given this body to all beings with a body for their happiness. Let them do whatever they please with it. They can hit it, insult it, or even kill it.

academic_translation:
Whether they play with my body,
Or make it a source of ridicule and jest,
Since I have already given this body away,
What is the use of caring for it?
translation: They can play with my body. They can laugh at it and make fun of it. Since I have already given this body away, why should I take care of it?

academic_translation:
Any action that does not bring harm to them,
Whatever it may be, let them do it;
Focusing upon me, at any time,
May it never be meaningless for anyone.
translation: Let them do any action to me, as long as it does not hurt them. Whenever anyone focuses on me, may it always be helpful to them. May it never be useless.
